profile.company_description: Handy Helperly is one point of contact for home services. We coordinate repairs, property preparation, cleaning, junk removal, packing, moving, storage, and new-home setup for homeowners and Realtors before, during, and after a move. We also take on single home-service projects, from one repair to a few rooms of painting. Serving Greater St. Louis and St. Charles County. Call (636) 459-1530 or request service at handyhelperly.com.

posts.label: Packing tips
posts.headline: Packing without the panic
steps: Start with what you don't use daily
Seasonal items, books, and decor go first.
Chargers, sheets, basic tools, toilet paper.
Hand off what you'd rather not do
posts.ig_caption:
Packing without the panic.

1. Start with what you don't use daily. Seasonal items, books, and decor go first.
2. Label boxes by room, not by contents.
3. Pack an open-first box: chargers, sheets, basic tools, toilet paper.
4. Hand off what you'd rather not do. We coordinate packing help.

Ask about packing through the link in our bio.
